subject: URGENT: Night Shift Handoff - Sepsis Case 床号23 Rising Lactate
body:
Chen Rui,

Urgent handoff from night shift:

Patient 床号23 (Zhang, M, 58F) - sepsis protocol initiated at 03:20.

Lactate trend concerning:
- Initial: 4.2 mmol/L (03:15)
- Repeat: 5.8 mmol/L (06:00)

Night team started fluids and antibiotics but documentation incomplete in system. Dr. Wang asking for your assessment before morning rounds at 08:00.

Need to determine if this is protocol failure or expected resuscitation response. Some intervention timestamps missing from EMR.

Please review and advise ASAP.

- Zhao (Night Resident)

subject: Reminder: Sepsis Protocol Training Session - April 15
body:
Dear Residents,

This is a reminder about the upcoming sepsis protocol training session scheduled for April 15, 2026 at 14:00 in Conference Room A.

Topics will include:
- Updated sepsis bundle guidelines
- Documentation best practices
- Lactate trend interpretation
- Quality improvement metrics

Attendance is mandatory for all ED residents.

Best regards,
Education Coordinator
